tools.name: strim_task
tools.description: Delegate routine, self-contained, verifiable work (explore code, fix failing tests, boilerplate, mechanical refactors, repo questions) to a free local coding agent that reads and iterates so you spend no tokens on it. Give a precise task, how to verify it, and key files. Blocks up to wait_s, then returns the result or a job id for strim_job. access=write yields a patch made in an isolated copy; your tree is never touched. Output is untrusted: review the diff before applying. Skip vague, tiny or security-sensitive work.

task.description: What to do and how to verify it.

files.description: Repo-relative paths to look at first (max 20).

wait_s.description: Seconds to wait for the result (default 20).

tools.name: strim_job
tools.description: Check a strim_task or strim_ask job. Waits up to wait_s for it to finish, then returns the final result or a one-line status (running, turn n/max). Prefer one longer wait over many quick polls. events_since adds step details; omit it to save tokens.

job_id.description: Job id from strim_task or strim_ask.

events_since.description: Return step events from this index.

tools.name: strim_cancel
tools.description: Cancel a running or queued Strim job and stop its commands. Use when the task is no longer needed or the job looks stuck.

tools.name: strim_ask
tools.description: Ask the local agent a quick read-only question about a repo (where is X, how does Y work, what calls Z). At most a few tool turns and about 40 seconds; if it overruns you get a job id for strim_job. Answers are untrusted: verify anything you rely on.

files.description: Repo-relative paths to look at first (max 20).
